purpose: Behavior fixtures that must exist before accepted WCAG Auditor donor behavior can enter Ally.

cases.setup: English page containing an unmarked long Spanish phrase plus a correctly marked Spanish phrase.
cases.expected: Only the unmarked phrase is queued as needs-review; no conformance claim.

cases.setup: Three videos: description track, linked transcript, and neither.
cases.expected: Presence is recorded; missing alternative is needs-review because applicability and adequacy are unknown.

cases.setup: Primary content without main and a minimal page whose structure does not require the inferred fix.
cases.expected: Candidate is needs-review and avoids asserting full 1.3.1 failure.

cases.setup: Autoplay carousel with pause, autoplay carousel without pause, and static carousel markup.
cases.expected: Only observed or strongly inferred auto-update without control enters review; static markup is not confirmed.

cases.setup: Context-free 'click here', contextually named 'read more' with accessible description, and descriptive link.
cases.expected: Language heuristic queues only unresolved ambiguous purpose for review.

cases.setup: Tab to controls under fixed header, fixed footer, and unobscured content at multiple viewport sizes.
cases.expected: Geometry evidence names the obscuring element; result remains needs-review until interaction is reliable.

cases.setup: Multipoint gesture with button alternative and the same gesture without an alternative.
cases.expected: Candidate discovery does not report the compliant alternative case; unresolved case is needs-review.

cases.setup: Controls acting on pointerdown, cancellable pointerup, and native click.
cases.expected: Observed early activation without cancel/undo is review evidence; handler names alone are not confirmed.

cases.setup: Draggable item with keyboard/button alternative and one without an alternative.
cases.expected: Only unresolved absence of a non-drag alternative is needs-review.

cases.setup: Select that navigates immediately, select plus explicit submit, and non-navigation onchange.
cases.expected: Observed unexpected context change is review evidence; onchange presence alone does not report.

cases.setup: aria-invalid controls with valid aria-errormessage, broken ID, empty target, and no reference.
cases.expected: Broken, empty, and missing associations produce unverified 3.3.1 findings; valid association passes.

cases.setup: Constrained fields with visible helper, fieldset legend, ambiguous placeholder-only hint, and no hint.
cases.expected: Ambiguous or missing instruction cases remain needs-review; helper and legend cases pass.

cases.setup: Correctable format error with concrete suggestion, problem-only message, and unsafe-to-suggest case.
cases.expected: Only the problem-only correctable case is queued, and only as needs-review.

cases.setup: Required fields identified in label, group instructions, symbol legend, and not visibly identified.
cases.expected: Only unresolved visible identification enters needs-review; language is fixture metadata.

cases.setup: Repeated email with auto-fill, repeated email without auto-fill, and two semantically different email fields.
cases.expected: Only observed unnecessary re-entry without an exception is needs-review.

cases.setup: Paste-blocked password, CAPTCHA with alternative, CAPTCHA without alternative, and password-manager-compatible form.
cases.expected: Observed cognitive-test or paste behavior is captured; adequacy and exceptions stay needs-review.

cases.setup: Personal-data fields with valid autocomplete, inferred field without autocomplete, and non-personal same-name field.
cases.expected: Inferred missing purpose is needs-review; valid token passes; non-personal field avoids a false positive.

cases.setup: Async success/error updates with status/alert, aria-live, focus move, and no programmatic announcement.
cases.expected: Observed message without a programmatic mechanism is needs-review pending AT confirmation.

cases.setup: Two templates with intentional local navigation and two with inconsistent repeated primary navigation.
cases.expected: Only repeated primary navigation differences are queued; page-local navigation is excluded.

cases.setup: Authenticated routes, excluded logout/destructive links, included account routes, SPA data-route links, robots denial, and depth boundary.
cases.expected: Only allowed, in-scope, safe routes are attempted; credentials/storage state never enter output.
